title: Reconcile the 2.3 adopter fleet and Proving Ground package boundary

preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: ForgeLink, ForgeWire, SkillForge, Moto One Hyper, and RepoPact Proving Ground each declare the intended current RepoPact release on their public default branch, with exact PyPI pins or checksum-backed vendored parity as appropriate.

RepoPact Proving Ground uses the supported package import and CLI boundary, links back to RepoPact's public research protocol instead of nonexistent local research paths, and its governance, PactBench, fixture, and S5 drift checks pass from its declared dependency environment.
The deterministic fleet verifier passes against immutable remote default-branch heads; Moto parity is proven through its declared overlay/checksum contract rather than a version marker alone.
Each adopter change has repository-native validation and dated evidence, unrelated downstream work remains unstaged, and no evidence claims GitHub Actions or cross-platform CI has been restored.
